Export Instructions

  1. Click Fullscreen, then Clean Preview Mode so only the 9:16 frame is visible.
  2. Use a screen recorder that can capture a fixed region — record only the 9:16 composition, not the surrounding black area.
  3. If your recorder supports a fixed resolution, set it to 1080 × 1920 (portrait).
  4. Record at 30fps or 60fps for smooth motion.
  5. Press Restart, start your recording, then press Play immediately.
  6. Import the recording into CapCut (or your editor of choice).
  7. Add sound design / music separately — audio hooks are timed in the code comments.
  8. Export the final video as MP4 (H.264) at 1080 × 1920.
